roleTemplates.standard-club.name: Standard club
roleTemplates.standard-club.description: A typical club setup with Admin, Board Member and Member roles.
roleTemplates.standard-club.roles.admin: Full system access, bypasses all permission checks
roleTemplates.standard-club.roles.boardm: Elevated access: can manage members, groups, events and finances
roleTemplates.standard-club.roles.member: Basic read-only access to club resources
roleTemplates.small-association.name: Small association
roleTemplates.small-association.descript: Minimal setup for small associations: Admin and Member roles only.
roleTemplates.small-association.roles.me: Can view members and events, and vote in polls
roleTemplates.makerspace.name: Makerspace
roleTemplates.makerspace.description: Makerspace setup with Admin, Operator and Member roles.
roleTemplates.makerspace.roles.operator: Can manage inventory, events and member access, but not finances
roleTemplates.makerspace.roles.member: Can view resources, use inventory and take part
